name: update
about: A 15-23 s update film ("vX is out"): a hook on the version, 2-4 changes each shown as a lit product moment on one camera strip with the film's one 3D turn, one payoff, the end card with the version. Every slot deals one of two devices per film (src/deal.ts) and every line one confident move. new-film.sh --format update lays these files over the Remotion starter.

music.about: Every update film is cut to a licensed, human-made, instrumental track (references/music.md): the track carries the film and earshot effects mark its hits; never effects only.
music.pick: find this film's own track: node scripts/music.mjs search --mood "<the film's mood words>" --bpm 116-128 --length <s>, then music.mjs sheet --measure and music.mjs get '#n' --to audio/music (its licence record beside it; never the last film's track); 116-128 BPM suits the template's two bars a change
music.add: bash scripts/new-film.sh <dir> --format update --music <file> --title T --artist A --source S --page URL --licence L --seen-quote Q --seen-url URL, or later: python3 scripts/audio/track.py add <file> ...
then: python3 scripts/audio/track.py edit --bars N --reveal-bar K --end stop|button|ring

next: update film: fill src/update.ts (the version, the one before it, 2-4 changes: one plain sentence each, 2-6 words, the result the user sees; "[]" where a product it works with sits, its logo slug and logoName),
fetch the real mark of each product a change names: node scripts/logos.mjs get <name> --film .,
see the devices this film was dealt: npx tsx -e "import { DEAL, LINES } from './src/deal'; console.log(DEAL, LINES)" (src/deal.ts: PIN a slot, or SEED to re-deal),

an approve change's four real pictures (update.ts changes[].photos) when the review is of pictures: node scripts/assets.mjs search "<subject>" --kind photo --fit 1:1, get '#n' --to public/assets, grade,
rebuild the product's own screens for each change where the kit stands in, then deal its direction: python3 scripts/deck.py --brief "<one line>" --format update --changes N

deal.seed: the product's name (IDENTITY.name), or SEED in src/deal.ts; PIN chooses a slot by hand, MOVE_PIN and EXIT_PIN a line's move and exit
deal.print: npx tsx -e "import { DEAL, LINES } from './src/deal'; console.log(DEAL, LINES)"

stage.slate: the strip on the mid slate
stage.paper: the strip on the tinted paper

hook.roll: the name over giant numerals cropped by the frame; the old version's last numeral rolls to the new one
hook.mask: the name, then, once it is read, the new version rises whole out of a mask on its baseline, giant and cropped

turn.yaw: the strip yaws 18 degrees round as the camera travels into the second change, easing most of the way back
turn.pitch: the camera tips 20 degrees down over the strip as the payoff gathers it

payoff.pull: the camera pulls back over every change, softened into a far plane, as the version swings in from the right
payoff.rise: the last change recedes out of focus and the version rises out of a mask in front of it

end.set: the version steps back, smaller and quieter, to the upper right; the mark and the name are set lower left
end.beside: the version settles at the name's size after it: mark, name and version as one centred lockup (the name rises in place out of its mask)

lines.moves: each line (the name, each change) arrives on mask, land, fall or glide (fx/TypePresets), never the same move twice in a row, and leaves on slide, spread, collapse, push or drop
